parameters.query:
SELECT q.query_id,q.query,(q.embedding IS NULL) AS missing_query_embedding,
  (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM rag.documents WHERE embedding IS NULL) AS missing_document_embeddings
FROM rag.test_queries q ORDER BY q.query_id
LIMIT NULLIF($1::integer,0);

-- $1 é o experiment_name. Aquecimento é excluído.
WITH measured AS (
  SELECT * FROM rag.test_searches
  WHERE experiment_name=$1
    AND configuration->>'evaluator'='simple_v2'
    AND status=coalesce(configuration->>'completed_status','completed')
    AND NOT (configuration->>'is_warmup')::boolean
), timing AS (
  SELECT query_id,method,
    array_agg(latency_ms ORDER BY (configuration->>'repetition')::integer) AS latency_samples,
    array_agg((configuration->>'repetition')::integer ORDER BY (configuration->>'repetition')::integer) AS repetitions
  FROM measured GROUP BY query_id,method
), first_measurement AS (
  SELECT * FROM measured WHERE (configuration->>'repetition')::integer=1
)
SELECT s.query_id,q.query,q.query_class,s.method,s.top_k,s.configuration,
  t.latency_samples,t.repetitions,
  (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM rag.test_labels l WHERE l.query_id=s.query_id AND l.label='Exact') AS exact_count,
  (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM rag.test_labels l WHERE l.query_id=s.query_id AND l.label='Partial') AS partial_count,
  coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('rank',r.rank,'product_id',r.product_id,'label',l.label) ORDER BY r.rank)
    FROM rag.test_results r LEFT JOIN rag.test_labels l ON l.query_id=s.query_id AND l.product_id=r.product_id
    WHERE r.search_id=s.id),'[]'::jsonb) AS results
FROM first_measurement s
JOIN timing t ON t.query_id=s.query_id AND t.method=s.method
JOIN rag.test_queries q ON q.query_id=s.query_id
ORDER BY s.query_id,s.method;
